accessibility.wcag_compliance: AA minimum, high contrast ratios on buttons and badges

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes. Implement full product catalog, sales recording, purchases recording with payment proof image upload, stock tracking, and cash flow overview. Use Tailwind CSS and Shadcn primitives.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Do not use complete transparent background on headers or overlays.
Maintain high contrast ratios and accessible typography.
